# Yashmeen Future Building & Fit-Out Contracting

> Dubai-based ISO-certified interior fit-out, architecture, bespoke joinery, and MEP engineering studio delivering turnkey commercial, residential, and hospitality spaces across the UAE since 2016.

## Company Overview
- **Company Name:** Yashmeen Future Building & Fit-Out Contracting
- **Founder & Managing Director:** Mohammad Danish Adnan
- **Established:** 2016 (10+ Years Active)
- **Head Office & Design Studio:** Bay Square, Building 12 - Office G01, Marasi Dr - Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
- **Production Facility:** 35,000 sq.ft In-House Joinery, Metal, Glass & Upholstery Facility in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE
- **Team Size:** 200+ in-house architects, interior designers, MEP engineers, project managers, and master craftsmen
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 (Quality), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental), ISO 45001:2015 (Health & Safety)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +971 54 386 2870
- **Email:** info@yfbfitoutcontracting.com
